nodes.label: ByteTrack-style tracker with IoU and 3D matching
nodes.norm_label: bytetrack-style tracker with iou and 3d matching
nodes.rationale: 3D distance matching keeps an object's ID when the detector redraws its box with a very different shape.

nodes.label: Single plain wget -c for large downloads
nodes.norm_label: single plain wget -c for large downloads
nodes.rationale: Multi-connection aria2 is throttled per client on Zenodo and corrupted files on exFAT; never mix downloaders on one file.

nodes.label: Say upfront whether a speed-up trick will help
nodes.norm_label: say upfront whether a speed-up trick will help
nodes.rationale: If a task is bound by an outside limit such as Zenodo throughput, say so plainly instead of offering tweaks.

nodes.label: Start tmux and the job in one command
nodes.norm_label: start tmux and the job in one command
nodes.rationale: Splitting tmux new from the commands runs them outside tmux or collides with an existing session.

nodes.label: Verify process state with evidence before claiming it
nodes.norm_label: verify process state with evidence before claiming it
nodes.rationale: Ask for pgrep, tmux ls or file-size output before saying a process runs, stopped or is protected.

nodes.label: Memories anchored in meters via D415 depth
nodes.norm_label: memories anchored in meters via d415 depth
nodes.rationale: Depth turns each detection into a 3D point so zones and answers are in meters; proof is position error against tape measure.

nodes.label: Keep FP16 as the default detector engine
nodes.norm_label: keep fp16 as the default detector engine
nodes.rationale: Loci is camera-bound with about 24 ms spare per frame and a missed object costs more than 2 ms; INT8 is kept for when the VLM shares the GPU.

nodes.label: Zero-shot YOLOE misnames classes
nodes.rationale: Headphones are labelled glasses and a desk and phone are labelled laptop; if naming stays poor, fine-tune on own photos (spec fallback).

nodes.label: Duplicate removal: per-class NMS plus containment rule
nodes.norm_label: duplicate removal: per-class nms plus containment rule
nodes.rationale: Thresholds IoU 0.5 and containment 0.6 were picked from measured duplicate boxes on live D415 frames, e.g. one lens inside the box of a whole pair of glasses.

nodes.label: GPU depth is opt-in; CPU path is the default
nodes.norm_label: gpu depth is opt-in; cpu path is the default
nodes.rationale: The CPU path stays the default until measured numbers justify the GPU path; the GPU path was about 3.7x slower at one or two boxes.

nodes.label: Load TensorRT engine before starting RealSense pipeline
nodes.norm_label: load tensorrt engine before starting realsense pipeline
nodes.rationale: Otherwise TensorRT CUDA graph capture fails.

nodes.label: INT8 trades 2.8 mAP points for 3.1x speed
nodes.norm_label: int8 trades 2.8 map points for 3.1x speed
nodes.rationale: INT8 inference is 3.1x faster than PyTorch and 1.26x faster than FP16, for -2.8 points of mAP50-95.

nodes.label: Build librealsense with BUILD_EXAMPLES=false
nodes.rationale: examples/CMakeLists.txt always links OpenGL::GL, so graphical examples off breaks cmake; command-line tools still build.

nodes.label: Python pre/post-processing dominates end-to-end time
nodes.rationale: About 46 percent of INT8 end-to-end time; the cost the fused CUDA preprocessing is meant to remove.

nodes.label: Parcel3D is synthetic; real-image accuracy unmeasured
nodes.norm_label: parcel3d is synthetic; real-image accuracy unmeasured
nodes.rationale: All test scores are on synthetic images; real D415 or Roboflow evaluation is still pending.

nodes.label: D415 needs a USB 3.2 link for 30 FPS
nodes.norm_label: d415 needs a usb 3.2 link for 30 fps
nodes.rationale: A USB 2.1 link limits colour to 15 FPS and 30 FPS times out; the camera must use a USB-A port.

nodes.label: Model-assisted labelling loop
nodes.rationale: Hand-label about 150 photos, train a first model, let it pre-label the rest, correct, retrain.

nodes.label: Own-object dataset v1 dropped (Oct 15 2026)
nodes.rationale: The user judged the photos not good enough, and the YOLOE-26l pre-labels were sparse (292 draft boxes, mostly laptop); the user will re-collect.

nodes.label: 8 GB memory budget table
nodes.rationale: The budget only closes because one model does both seeing and reasoning; a second resident LLM would not fit.

nodes.norm_label: sqlite event and 3d position store with caption vector index

nodes.norm_label: planned 256 gb nvme for keyframes and swap

nodes.norm_label: pytorch to onnx to tensorrt speed-up table

nodes.label: Jetson Orin Nano Super dev kit (8 GB)
nodes.norm_label: jetson orin nano super dev kit (8 gb)

nodes.label: Project status log (Gate 1 passed Oct 13, Week 2 started Oct 14)
nodes.norm_label: project status log (gate 1 passed oct 13, week 2 started oct 14)

nodes.label: One resident VLM within 8 GB shared memory
nodes.norm_label: one resident vlm within 8 gb shared memory
nodes.rationale: Memory is the constraint: 8 GB shared by CPU and GPU, so only one resident VLM.

nodes.label: Every layer has a primary choice and a fallback
nodes.norm_label: every layer has a primary choice and a fallback
nodes.rationale: Pick the fallback only when the primary is shown not to work.

nodes.label: llama.cpp first for the VLM, Edge-LLM later
nodes.norm_label: llama.cpp first for the vlm, edge-llm later
nodes.rationale: llama.cpp needs no export step; Edge-LLM export needs an x86 NVIDIA GPU or Thor, which the user does not have on hand.

nodes.label: Do not write project code until the user says to start
nodes.norm_label: do not write project code until the user says to start
nodes.rationale: The user gives the first steps and requirements one at a time; follow the 8-week plan gates in order.

nodes.label: LLM as compiler: watch rules compiled to JSON checked in C++
nodes.norm_label: llm as compiler: watch rules compiled to json checked in c++
nodes.rationale: No language model in the hot loop; rules are unit-testable and the user confirms each compiled rule.

nodes.label: MCP-native tool surface for any agent
nodes.norm_label: mcp-native tool surface for any agent
nodes.rationale: Any MCP client can use the memory over Streamable HTTP with token auth; NeMo Agent Toolkit and Agentforce are named clients.

nodes.label: Separate systemd processes for perception, VLM worker and agent
nodes.norm_label: separate systemd processes for perception, vlm worker and agent
nodes.rationale: A VLM crash never stops perception, and each process can be restarted, profiled and tested alone.

nodes.label: Build from source for sm_87 on JetPack 7.2
nodes.norm_label: build from source for sm_87 on jetpack 7.2
nodes.rationale: A June 2026 setup guide found JetPack 6 containers and wheels crashed, fell back to CPU or gave bad output on JetPack 7.2, while source builds worked.

nodes.label: Two-speed perception: cheap per-frame loop, VLM only on events
nodes.norm_label: two-speed perception: cheap per-frame loop, vlm only on events
nodes.rationale: Proof is VLM calls per hour with and without gating at the same event recall.

nodes.label: CUDA architecture 87 (Orin, compute capability 8.7)
nodes.rationale: JetPack keeps nvcc out of PATH, so CMake is pointed at /usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc and built for sm_87.

nodes.label: Install JetPack on microSD (no NVMe fitted)
nodes.norm_label: install jetpack on microsd (no nvme fitted)
nodes.rationale: The default Install on NVMe option fails at partitioning when no NVMe is fitted; the microSD option works.

nodes.label: workers=1 batch=2 PIN_MEMORY=False to stay within 8 GB
nodes.norm_label: workers=1 batch=2 pin_memory=false to stay within 8 gb
nodes.rationale: Larger worker and batch settings froze the board during training.
